notes: Vanilla wowsims does not model an Arcane-specific preset (the fork's mage/apls/p1.apl.json is Fire, ui/mage/apls/forever_frost.apl.json is Frost), so this was built from Forever's own Arcane talent tree plus a community guide, not a direct port. Fix round 1: two of this guide's own lines are presently inert in this engine build and are kept anyway per the fix-round-1 controller ruling, so the file states the intended design and upgrades itself once the engine catches up -- (1) Arcane Blast (400574): sim/mage/talents.go says outright the package does not register this spell yet; (2) the Missile Barrage gate on Arcane Missiles (400589): no aura is ever created under that id, because this package's Arcane Missiles channel is not re-costed/re-timed for the proc (also noted in sim/mage/talents.go). Both lines cast nothing today -- `notes` on each says so -- and an unconditional Arcane Missiles cast is added at the bottom of the priority list as the engine-castable Era filler that keeps this rotation actually dealing damage in the meantime; Era Arcane (before Arcane Blast existed) was itself an Arcane Missiles-spam rotation, so this is not a downgrade in spirit, only in ceiling. Arcane Missiles' own top rank (25345, rank 8) is also excluded by an off-by-one in the engine's registration loop (sim/mage/arcane_missiles.go: `for rank := 1; rank < ArcaneMissilesRanks; rank++`, so rank 8 never registers); every Arcane Missiles reference here uses 10212 (rank 7), the highest rank the engine actually registers, with the missing rank 8 recorded as an engine follow-up. Arcane Power and Presence of Mind are both confirmed castable and are kept on cooldown, off the GCD-costing category, ahead of a specific nuke. Every rank named here (other than the two flagged inert conditions) is checked against the spellconst of the newest client build in builds/.
